M6-partial: Sparse 2:4 GPU test status
=======================================

GPU sparse GEMM tests (TestSparseGpuGfx950 in test_gemm_sparse.py) are
currently skipped because no gfx950-specific 2:4 sparse kernel YAML was
located in the repository at M6-partial implementation time.

To enable GPU sparse tests:
1. Locate or generate a sparse GEMM kernel YAML targeting gfx950
   (look in tensilelite/Tensile/Tests/ or a library logic directory).
2. Load the solution via enumerateAllSolutions, filter for sparse kernels
   (SparseA=True or CompressedA=True in the solution dict).
3. Allocate compressed A and metadata via compress24() from sparse.py.
4. Run the kernel and compare against the dense reference via gemm().

The compress24/decompress24 CPU functions (sparse.py) are fully tested
by TestCompress24 and TestDecompress24FromKnown in test_gemm_sparse.py.
